description: This file defines a module management system for Kivy applications, including classes and functions to load, activate, deactivate, and configure modules dynamically, as well as handle module paths and user interactions.

classes.name: ModuleContext
classes.description: Represents the context for a module, holding its configuration data.

classes.name: ModuleBase
classes.description: Handles loading, importing, activating, deactivating, and configuring Kivy modules for applications.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Adds a directory to the module search path and loads modules from it.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of available modules.

methods.name: import_module
methods.description: Imports a module by name, trying both 'kivy.modules' namespace and direct import.

methods.name: activate_module
methods.description: Activates a specified module for a window.

methods.name: deactivate_module
methods.description: Deactivates a specified module for a window.

methods.name: register_window
methods.description: Adds a window to the internal list and updates module states.

methods.name: unregister_window
methods.description: Removes a window from the internal list and updates module states.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates module activation status based on current configuration for all windows.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures all loaded modules based on current configuration.

methods.name: _configure_module
methods.description: Internal method to configure a specific module, including importing and setting its config.

methods.name: usage_list
methods.description: Prints a list of available modules with their descriptions.
